q: Who led the Israelites out of Egypt?
exp: Moses led the Israelites out of Egypt in the Exodus.

q: How many books are in the Bible?
exp: The Bible has 66 books — 39 in the Old Testament and 27 in the New Testament.
Judas Iscariot betrayed Jesus for thirty pieces of silver.

q: The first book of the Bible is...
exp: Genesis is the first book of the Bible.

q: Who was the mother of Jesus?
exp: Mary was the mother of Jesus.

q: The Ten Commandments were given to Moses on...
exp: The Ten Commandments were given to Moses on Mount Sinai.
